  ?policyCoverageDetail in:hasPolicy ?policy.
  ?policyCoverageDetail in:hasPolicyHolder ?policyHolder.
  ?policyHolder in:hasPolicyHolderId ?agentId.
  ?policyHolder in:soldByAgent ?agent.
  ?claim in:hasPolicyCoverageDetail ?policyCoverageDetail.
  ?claim in:hasLossPayment ?lossPayment.
  ?lossPayment in:lossPaymentAmount ?lossPaymentAmount.
  ?policyCoverageDetail in:hasPremiumAmount ?premium.
  ?premium in:premiumAmount ?premiumAmount.
  FILTER (?totalPremium > 0)
}
GROUP BY ?policyNumber ?agentId
